praveen: Heads-up — planning a staggered nonblocking backfill for user_flags table this Thu 02:00 UTC. DDL is trivial (add column + default) but backfill touches ~150M rows. Will try zero-lock strategy, but plan includes a short exclusive lock for final switch. Canary for 15m. Blocking?
maya: fine with window, avoid running during analytics job (01:30-03:00). canary sounds good.
sam: how long do you expect the exclusive lock to be? and what metrics to watch?
praveen: exclusive lock should be <60s if everything goes well. watching row_write_latency, replica_lag, and streaming lag. will gate canary on replica_lag <5s for last 10m.
praveen: rollout plan: 1) apply DDL with no default (instant) 2) kick off chunked backfill job (non-locking, batched) 3) after progress >=98% hold short lock to write default + finalize index 4) release.
ryan: if the short lock spikes, do we have an automatic fallback?
praveen: yes — fallback is to abort final step and spawn read-repair job that updates rows lazily, mark rollout paused, and rollback application feature flag.
linda: create a canary route pinned to migration-branch for 15m, then gradual 10% increments if metrics look ok.
praveen: pinned canary image + DB migration tag noted. I'll push release notes and pin version in releases dashboard.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] migration job queued: migrations/user_flags_add_default_v3.sql -> job id mf-9823. Triggered by praveen.
ops-bot: [ops-bot] scheduled change window Thu 2024-06-06 02:00 UTC in calendar (owner: praveen). Pager duty: oncall @sam.
sam: I'll be oncall and available. If replica_lag >5s for 5m during canary, I'll abort.
maya: please post the db checksum and estimated remaining rows mid-backfill. small replies only.
praveen: will post checkpoints every 10m. quick config snippet for backfill:
```
-- backfill config
batch_size = 5000
concurrency = 6
max_duration_seconds = 600
checkpoint_interval_seconds = 600
```
praveen: final note — if we see lock contention on master, we'll switch to read-repair fallback and open a rollback window. tagging @linda for rollout gating. :eyes:
linda: acknowledged. thanks for the plan.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] mf-9823 started on canary pool at 2024-06-06T02:00:10Z. logs -> https://ci.internal/jobs/mf-9823/log
ops-bot: [ops-bot] reminder 30m until window.
praveen: will update thread during run with short logs and final decision.
